releases.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
releases.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

releases.name: Cheerleaders Boys: Naughty School Spirit
releases.summary:
A squad of guys cheering only for you. Play their games, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!

On this campus, the loudest guys in the stadium aren’t on the field. They’re the cheer squad, and from the first practice they can’t stop looking your way.

Jump into a run of minigames: quick quiz rounds, reflex tests, timing challenges and more. The boys shout your name when you nail it and laugh with you when you don’t. Every win moves the story forward and opens a new image in your gallery.

There’s the confident captain who flirts like it’s part of the routine, the quiet flyer who only opens up after practice, and the rival who pretends he isn’t keeping score. Each one has something to show you, if you stick around long enough.

How far will you go to become the one they’re really cheering for?

releases.name: Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish!
releases.summary:
Don't just watch the race — run it! Control your heroine directly in high-speed derby-style racing action.

Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish! is a racing action game where you don't watch from the stands — you're in the race, controlling one of the heroines yourself.

■ You're the one running
You control the heroine herself as she tears down the track. Fight for position in the pack, and choose the perfect moment to burn your dash gauge — it never recharges, so timing is everything. Grab orbs on the track to trigger skills, use items to slow your rivals or boost yourself, and save your special move — one use per race — for the moment that decides it all.
Each heroine has her own running style, from front-runners who set the pace to closers who bet everything on the final stretch. Find the style that fits her, and make it count.

■ 55 races to conquer
Five stages, 55 races in all. Finish in the top 3 to move on. Rivals get tougher with every stage, while field sizes and race distances keep changing. Combine 15 skills and 12 special moves to build your own way to win.

releases.name: Big Golden Rock
releases.summary: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

releases.name: Gravity Switch
releases.summary: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

releases.name: PiyottoPlanet
releases.summary:
Drop × Rotate the Board = A New Merge Puzzles! Play Solo or Battle It Out! Shake the Board, Build Big Chains!

Merge matching pieces to create bigger ones.
Simple rules, with a twist: you can move the board itself.

◆ Spin and Charge Shot Your Way to Total Chaos!
Use gyro controls or buttons to rotate the board
and completely rearrange your carefully stacked pieces.

Then charge up a piece and slam it down with extra force.
The impact can send nearby pieces shifting, turning the board into something completely unexpected.
And from that chaos, new matches and chain reactions can emerge.

▼ Single-Player Modes
Move the board as you take on high-score challenges and Time Attack.
Your scores are added to the leaderboard, where you can compete with players from around the world.

releases.name: Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Boys Obsession
releases.summary:
He smiles like he loves you. He watches like he owns you. Can you survive a guy who wants you all to himself?

Some guys fall in love. These guys fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every tender moment hides something that goes way too far.

Three anime boys. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, caught between attraction and something much harder to name, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The volatile one who loses it when you so much as glance at someone else. The calculated one with a perfect smile and a plan you weren't supposed to find out about.

Each date pulls you further into their world, and every choice feeds something neither of you can fully control.

A companion watches from the outside. They see the red flags you've decided to ignore. They warn you. The rest is on you.

releases.name: ONE-ROOM ZOMBIE
releases.summary:
A survival action game where you battle swarms of zombies in the confined space of a single room.

Attacks are automatic, keeping controls simple - just move and change direction.

Level up and select new weapons from treasure chests to expand your arsenal. Create the ultimate build and survive!

Use coins earned in battle to upgrade your starting weapons and stats. You can start the game with a build tailored to your own playstyle.

releases.name: MANIC MINER
releases.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

releases.name: Cheerleaders Girls: Naughty School Spirit
releases.summary:
The squad needs someone to cheer for, and they picked you. Win their games and unlock exclusive images!

Game day is coming and the campus cheer squad is missing one thing: someone who can keep up with them. Head to the field, the locker room and the bleachers, where every routine is a chance to get a little closer.

Take on a mix of minigames, from rapid-fire quiz rounds to reflex and timing challenges, while the girls cheer you on, tease you when you slip and celebrate every win. Clear them to push the story forward and unlock new images for your gallery.

The bubbly captain, the shy new girl, the rival who swears she isn’t impressed. Each one has her own vibe and her own way of showing she likes you.

So, can you keep up with the squad, or will they leave you on the bench?

releases.name: Japan Bus Simulator
releases.summary:
"Japan Bus Simulator" is a simulation game that combines driving a route bus with managing a bus company. The setting is a fictional town reminiscent of a Japanese city. 

Start with a small office and one bus and grow your bus company to run throughout the town.

releases.name: Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus
releases.summary:
Sleepin' Guy Deluxe Edition is a first person action-puzzle game set in physics based worlds.
This new enhanced edition includes lots of improvements plus extra contents. You'll assume the role of a nice Big Guy that will need to wake up in order to save the most important thing in his life.

releases.name: Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Girls Obsession
releases.summary:
She smiles like she loves you. She watches like she owns you. Can you survive a girl who wants you all to herself?

Some girls fall in love. These girls fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every sweet moment hides something dangerous underneath.

Three anime girls. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, stuck in the middle of it all, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The explosive one who can't stand you looking at anyone else. The perfect one with a plan she hasn't told you yet.

Each date pulls you closer into their world, and each choice you make feeds something you might not be able to stop.

A companion watches it all from the outside. They see the signs. They warn you. Whether you listen is up to you.

releases.name: Picronix 3
releases.summary:
Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. 

Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image.

Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. 

Train your brain and find your inner peace.

releases.name: Egypt Farm
releases.summary:
Experience farming in Ancient Egypt! Raise animals, grow crops, manage your resources, and build a thriving farm in the heart of Egypt!

Choose between a male or female character and experience everyday life in the countryside. Plant and harvest a variety of vegetables, feed and raise animals, and sell your produce and livestock to earn money and expand your farm.

Gather valuable resources to develop your property. Hire workers to help collect wood, stone, and gold, allowing you to manage your time more efficiently and boost productivity.

Buy food to keep your animals well-fed, and don't forget to take care of yourself! Purchase food to restore your energy or head home for a good night's sleep to regain your strength.

Build your farm, manage your resources, and transform a small piece of Ancient Egypt into a prosperous farming empire.

releases.name: Niconico-san
releases.summary:
A creepy rumor has been spreading around school recently. 

“There’s a smiling man who beckons you over at a warehouse down a certain alley.” Those who see him are drawn to the warehouse and go missing.

One day, you find yourself needing to take that very alley on your way home. As you approach the warehouse, the door suddenly swings open, and a hand reaches out. The moment it pulls you in, you lose consciousness. When you wake up, you find yourself in a terrifying otherworld…

Trapped in this otherworld, you must find the items necessary to escape and return to the real world.

Can you find a way out of this horrifying place?

releases.name: Tiny Pizza
releases.summary:
Take over your uncle’s pizzeria! Mix, bake and master every pizza in this cozy game with adorable animal chefs.

Before you open the doors, there’s one thing to do: discover each recipe, master the art of making it and become the pizza chef you’re meant to be.

Step into a warm, sunny pizzeria, grab a bowl and start combining ingredients to see what delicious creation comes out of the oven.

Pick from a whole shelf of toppings - juicy tomatoes, salami, ham, mozzarella, bell peppers, corn, olives, chili and more. Drop them into the bowl, hit mix and find out if you’ve just cooked up a brand new recipe. Every discovery lands in your recipe book, so your favorites are always close at hand.

Then it’s time for the oven. Keep an eye on the gauge and pull your pizza out at just the right moment - not too pale, not too burnt, just perfectly golden.

New recipes bring experience points. Level up to unlock extra ingredient slots and try bolder, more creative combinations.

With warm hand-drawn art, cute animal chefs and a relaxed pace, Tiny Pizza is a perfect little treat for a quick break, a cozy evening or anyone who has ever dreamed of running their own tiny pizzeria.

releases.name: Security 51
releases.summary:
Security 51 is an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. 

You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien - you're not supposed to know. 

Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface.

releases.name: TANK Z
releases.summary: Tank Z is set in a 20XX that a zombie virus has already finished off. What’s left of humanity holds one city – Busan – and what’s left of its firepower is a single prototype tank somebody dug out of an old warehouse. That tank is you.

releases.name: Pup Champs
releases.summary: Lead a team of puppy soccer players, solve 130+ challenges and score goals in this cozy tactical puzzle game!

releases.name: Relaywardens
releases.summary: Build a squad of space mercenaries and fight through massive alien hordes. Collect crystals, recruit new units, unlock automatic abilities, and combine upgrades to create an army capable of surviving an entire hostile planet.

releases.name: Ball Scooping Friends
releases.summary: Experience the thrill of a Japanese festival with a unique twist! This online co-op game combines the fun of "Ball Scooping" (like goldfish scooping, but with balls!) and "Shooting Gallery" games.

releases.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
releases.summary:
You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware - there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

releases.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
releases.summary: Manage your camp, drill soldiers into specialized war machines and dominate turn-based battles. 12 Weeks. 9 Recruits. 1 Rule: break them or lose them.

releases.name: Fortune Avenue
releases.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

releases.name: Cascade
releases.summary: Paint spells. Break the cascade. Build four hand-crafted spells, survive an escalating action roguelite campaign, then push its Rift Depth 1-99 endgame.

releases.name: Reshine
releases.summary:
Clean away years of dust, rust and grime to restore forgotten treasures. No management, no pressure. Just relaxing, satisfying restoration at your own pace.

Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.

Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

releases.name: I Fell for the Florist: A Suspense Romance Adventure
releases.summary:
One night, he saved you. Now he will never let you go.

On your way home one night, you are attacked in a dark alley — and rescued by a quiet young man who runs the flower shop nearby.
His name is Minato Kurose.

Gentle and soft-spoken, he becomes the one person you can lean on. But that night, the two of you began to share a secret. And the deeper his love grows, the more he begins to break.

Every choice you make changes the fate of the five people around you: your best friend, your ex, your senior at work, Minato's younger sister, and the detective who will not stop asking questions.

Who will you protect? And who will you lose?

■ Features
- A dark suspense romance visual novel
- Your choices decide who lives and who dies
- 11 different endings — only one narrow path saves everyone
- See at a glance who is still alive, and look back on everyone's fate at the end of each chapter
- Auto-save and fast-forward for easy replays
- Playable in English and Japanese

releases.name: Brain Training Jigsaw Puzzle World Scenery
releases.summary:
Travel the world through 24 breathtaking views. A relaxing brain-training jigsaw puzzle, from 24 to 1,000 pieces.

Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa, and Oceania.
Piece together 24 breathtaking views from around the world.

The rocks of Ha Long Bay, the aurora over Iceland, the mirror sky of Salar de Uyuni, the lagoon of Bora Bora...
Fit each piece into place and watch a beautiful landscape slowly come to life.

■ From 24 to 1,000 pieces
Choose from 7 sizes: 24, 48, 96, 150, 300, 500, or 1,000 pieces.
Start small and easy, or settle in for a long 1,000-piece session.
All 24 pictures are available from the start.

■ Helpful features
・Show the reference picture anytime
・Show only the edge pieces
・Scatter the pieces to sort them again
・Zoom and Lock View

releases.name: Find the Needle (DEV 666)
releases.summary:
One tiny needle. One enormous haystack. Grab your tools. Start searching!

One tiny needle. A mountain of hay. An almost impossible challenge. Can you find it?

Find the Needle is a fun and addictive search game that turns the famous saying "finding a needle in a haystack" into a unique interactive experience!

What sounds like a simple task quickly becomes a real challenge. Somewhere inside a massive pile of hay, a tiny needle is waiting to be discovered. But don't worry — you have more than just your hands to help you!

Grab a rake, fire up your vacuum cleaner, scan the area with a metal detector, or hire workers to help you search. Every tool offers a different way to tackle the challenge.

Will you carefully search through the hay, rely on technology, or let a team of workers do the hard work? The choice is yours!

KEY FEATURES:

The Ultimate Needle Hunt: Take on the classic challenge of finding a tiny needle hidden somewhere in a giant haystack.

releases.name: Killer Toys 2
releases.summary:
Fast-paced rogue-like FPS chaos against deadly killer toys!

This fast-paced, rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a chaotic nightmare where killer toys have come to life — twitching, giggling, and out for blood.

Start each run by customizing your experience with unique modifiers: crank up the difficulty and tweak the rules to shape your run your way. Then pick your unlocked arena — from The Bouncy Castle to Candy World or even outer space — each with its own hazards and interactive traps.

Armed with only a pistol, you'll face waves of toys that charge, dash, fly, shoot, shield themselves, explode, and overwhelm you with sheer numbers. Smash them, collect glowing experience orbs, and level up to choose from powerful upgrades. Will you improve your damage, speed, or reload time? Unlock stronger weapons? Or summon explosive chaos to wipe out swarms at once? Every decision shapes your survival run.

As the arena fills with charging, exploding, and bullet-spewing toys, the game becomes a frantic dance of dodging, aiming, and managing your ammo while exploiting map hazards like explosive sweets or damaging zones to survive longer. The further you go, the crazier it gets — until you're finally overwhelmed. But every run earns progress, new arenas, and more chaos for your next rampage.

releases.name: Where are Leo and Mia? Jungle Adventure
releases.summary:
Swing into the jungle! Hunt for Leo and Mia hidden in lush, bustling scenes full of monkeys, toucans and sleepy tigers. A cozy hide-and-seek adventure for kids and parents.

Grab your explorer's hat and venture into the deep green jungle - the newest hide-and-seek adventure in the Where are Leo and Mia? series!
Somewhere in these lush, buzzing jungle scenes, two little adventurers are playing the world's best game of hide-and-seek. Leo is crouched behind a mossy temple stone, watching a troop of monkeys scamper past. Mia is tucked away somewhere in the leaves. Can you and your child spot them both?
Every scene is packed with life and tiny stories to discover together: monkeys swinging from the vines, toucans and parrots gliding overhead, a tiger dozing in a sunbeam, tiny frogs and butterflies hidden among the flowers. Slow down, point at the screen, laugh at the details - and cheer when you finally find Leo and Mia hiding in plain sight.
Made from the ground up for little ones and the grown-ups searching alongside them:
• Gentle, no-pressure gameplay - no timers, no losing, no scary bits
• Big, cute, colorful scenes made for pointing and exploring together
• Rewarding star animations and happy sounds every time you find someone
• Simple controls small hands can manage
• The perfect calm game for parent and child
Made for that special "I found them!" moment - and all the giggles that come with it. Welcome to the jungle. Leo and Mia are already hiding.

releases.name: Zumba - Christmas Marble Saga
releases.summary:
Protect the magic of Christmas—match, blast, and save the North Pole!

This festive journey invites you into a sparkling winter wonderland where a magical holiday wreath guards the joy of the season! Choose your snowy path, aim enchanted ornaments at winding ice-covered tracks, and match three or more identical colors to trigger joyful explosions before they enter the workshop. Secure high scores and earn up to three stars per level by clearing waves with the speed of a reindeer in flight.

Between stages, spend your gathered peppermint shards to unlock powerful holiday relics:
• Blizzard Blast: Shatters entire clusters with a burst of wintry frost.
• Ice Stasis: Freezes the rolling ornaments in their tracks, slowing them to a crawl.
• The North Star: Transmutes your next ornament into any color you need to complete a match.
• Gift Avalanche: Summons a barrage of falling presents to create instant festive matches.
• Nutcracker Strike: Targets a single, stubborn bauble for immediate destruction.
• Jingle Rewind: Plays a magical tune to reverse time and undo your last shot.

releases.name: Rebirth Blossom - The Spirit Chronicles
releases.summary:
Fly as a lost soul through an Asian spirit world and collect 220 soul fragments, each unlocking the story.

Rebirth Blossom: The Lotus of Life opens in the quiet space between life and death. You are a lost soul, called back from the edge of oblivion and sent on a single task: to save a princess from a dark power creeping across an ancient, Asian-inspired land. But nothing in the spirit world is quite as simple as it seems.

You drift forward on gentle wings, free to steer wherever you like. Floating among the scenery - petals over sleeping gardens, fog in the bamboo, light spilling from stone lanterns - are glowing soul fragments. Fly into one and a memory awakens: a voice, a moment, a piece of the story. Each stage holds 20 fragments to find, and across 11 stages that's 220 passages that slowly piece the whole tale together. Gather every fragment in an area and the way forward opens.

This first chapter is calm, beautiful, and quietly mysterious - a story of duty and rescue, with the first faint hints that something darker waits beneath. There is no pressure and no way to fail: drift into a hazard and you simply return to your last moment of progress, so the focus stays where it belongs - on flying, listening, and uncovering the truth.

releases.name: Thrifty Business
releases.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

releases.name: Calculus of Rot
releases.summary:
The world is dead. Mutants roam the ruins, and every step forward could be your last.

Explore dark, infected zones hidden beneath the fog of war. Reveal new paths, discover useful items, and carefully decide which enemies to confront. Every encounter costs resources, and every mistake brings you closer to death.

Study enemy strength, plan your route, and use your limited health and attacks wisely. Some monsters are worth the risk. Others should be avoided at all costs.

As you progress, stronger abominations begin to appear, turning each map into a deadly tactical puzzle where survival depends on smart decisions rather than luck.

releases.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
releases.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

releases.name: Machine Party
releases.summary:
Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. 

Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror.

releases.name: Tri6: Infinite 2
releases.summary: Tri6: Infinite 2 is futuristic arcade racing without brakes: race across procedurally generated cyber tracks, dodge traps, use power-ups, and experience thrilling high-speed action. Every run is unique — how long can you last?

releases.name: Feral Road
releases.summary: Choose your vehicle, deploy combat drones, and fight through a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Upgrade your defenses, create powerful drone builds, survive each stage, and reach the boss at the end of the road.

releases.name: BODYCAMERA: Drone Edition
releases.summary:
See the danger before it sees you. Deploy your drone. Rescue the hostage.

Every second counts. Every move matters. One mission: find the hostage and bring them home alive.

BODYCAMERA: Drone Edition is an immersive first-person tactical shooter that combines intense combat with drone reconnaissance and hostage rescue operations.

Step into a dangerous environment where enemies could be waiting around every corner. Your most valuable weapon isn't just your firearm — it's your drone.

Deploy your tactical drone to scout hostile areas, identify enemy positions, and locate the hostage before entering dangerous territory. Gather vital information, plan your movements, and use your surroundings to gain the upper hand.

Experience the action through a realistic bodycam-style perspective that brings you closer to the intensity of every encounter.

releases.name: Moon Cleaner
releases.summary: Moon Cleaner, the game.

releases.name: Mawkey The Last Macaw
releases.summary:
Mawkey The Last Macaw is a 2D pixel art adventure in which we control Mawkey, trying to prevent the destruction of the environment and the mistreatment of animals in Honduras.

Step into Mawkey's shoes and explore the linear world of Honduras, freeing animals and stopping the deforestation of evil businessman Adreim.

releases.name: Hadean Tactics
releases.summary: Hadean Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding game fused with autobattler elements to create a unique strategy experience. Use your cards to influence the actions of your units and help your Hero defeat the Six Wings of Hell!

releases.name: Piece by Piece
releases.summary:
It's time to open shop! 

Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

Customize your shop with different colours and materials, grow plants and mix paint, spruce up the items that pass through the store, bake cookies for your neighbours, and listen to the latest gossip - are you ready to roll up your sleeves and open up shop?

releases.name: Catch To Fish
releases.summary: Catch To Fish is a first-person fishing adventure across five tropical islands. Pick the right bait for each spot, time your cast and manage the line tension as you reel. Some of what you pull ashore will not go quietly: grab a club, a knife, a paddle or an anchor, or draw a pistol, shotgun, rifle or harpoon, and finish the fight on the sand.Sell your catch to each island's trader, buy better rods, weapons and a bigger bag, and complete the island's tasks to call out its sea monster. Every boss warns before it strikes – watch the marked ground, dodge the charge, sweep or spit, and hit back while it is open.FEATURES- Five islands to explore: Brinehook Bay, Reedveil Marsh, Emberreef Cay, Galecrag Reach and Moonwake Atoll- 75 species of fish, 30 baits and 10 rods- Fishing with real feel: bait choice, charged casts, line tension and reel assist options- Land fights with 4 melee weapons and 6 firearms, from a driftwood club to a tide harpoon- Five sea-monster bosses, each with its own attacks and warnings- 8 playable characters, each with a small perk- A journal that records every species you catch- Accessibility options: reel assist, tap to reel, a longer bite window, menu text size and high-contrast menus- Play in English, Turkish, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese

releases.name: Daisenryaku SSB 2
releases.summary:
Since 1985, the Daisenryaku series has defined modern war strategy games. On every battlefield, victory hinges on how you deploy forces, balance offense and defense, and break the deadlock - your “Grand Strategy” is put to the test.

Wield over 300 modern weapons, from jets to tanks, and outmaneuver rival forces with your strategy. From small islands to massive total-war maps, turn-based battles let both newcomers and veterans play at their own pace.

releases.name: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler
releases.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency.

releases.name: Final Kick Football Legends
releases.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

releases.name: Misblood
releases.summary:
Misblood is an arcade-style top-down shooter built around short, brutal, replayable missions. The city has a list of 25 contracts with your name on it: drive to the address, kick the door, and fight room by room until nobody is left standing. You are always outnumbered, deaths come fast, and restarts come faster — every mission is a plan you rewrite on the fly.

Fight with whatever the job hands you: pistol, rifle, shotgun or bat, backed by grenades and a split-second dash.

An open pixel-art city to cruise between jobs, and a list that only ends one way.
